objective: Complete the positive side of the source-traceable external ABCB1 candidate pool using official regulatory reports without changing the frozen v0.3-dev model, threshold, features, or applicability-domain rule.
source_scope: FDA integrated or clinical pharmacology review reports
strict_positive_rule: Identity-clean released parent drug with a human ABCB1-transfected assay and either matched parent or knockout background correction yielding net ER >= 2, or a transporter ER reduced by more than 50% to below 2 with a selective P-gp inhibitor. Positive-control and monolayer/recovery information are recorded when exposed.
secondary_rule: Keep Caco-2-only, qualitative, non-human, uncorrected, or incompletely exposed studies outside the formal strict metric even when the regulatory conclusion is directionally positive.
identity_rule: Exclude exact InChIKey or connectivity-block overlap with the frozen 443 training set, all development/external stress sets, Broccatelli 2012, and regulatory strict pool v2.
source_lineage_rule: A regulatory report is not automatically an independent experiment. Sponsor study identifiers, cited publications, metabolites, shared reports, and common assay vendors must be retained for source-clustered analysis.
modeling_rule: No model scoring, refit, threshold selection, feature selection, applicability-domain modification, calibration, or candidate inclusion change using batch3 outcomes.
formal_gate: The batch may update the frozen candidate ledger only after PDF-page verification, structure standardization, identity-overlap audit, evidence-tier adjudication, and source-lineage fields are complete.
